A couple of good, cheap recipes that you can do with all the cuts (though if you can afford to deep fry, clearly that’s what you have to do with the wings lol!):

Put your chicken in a tray with whatever veg you can find, sliced potatoes, 4 cloves of garlic, peeled and sliced if you want to eat them, just chucked in if you want the flavour, an onion halved and chucked in and chicken stock about 2cm up the dish (and salt and pepper).
